verses.en: Ask ye of the LORD rain in the time of the latter rain; so the LORD shall make bright clouds, and give them showers of rain, to every one grass in the field.
verses.pt: Pedi, vós, ao SENHOR chuva no tempo da chuva tardia; o SENHOR faz relâmpagos, e lhes dará chuva abundante, e erva no campo a cada um.
verses.en_web: Ask of Yahweh rain in the spring time, Yahweh who makes storm clouds, and he gives rain showers to everyone for the plants in the field.
verses.en_bbe: Make your request to the Lord for rain in the time of the spring rains, even to the Lord who makes the thunder-flames; and he will give them showers of rain, to every man grass in the field.

verses.en: For the idols have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie, and have told false dreams; they comfort in vain: therefore they went their way as a flock, they were troubled, because there was no shepherd.
verses.pt: Pois os ídolos falam ilusão, e os adivinhos veem falsidade, e falado sonhos ilusórios; com ilusão consolam; por isso eles foram embora como ovelhas, humilhadas, porque não havia pastor.
verses.en_web: For the teraphim have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie; and they have told false dreams. They comfort in vain. Therefore they go their way like sheep. They are oppressed, because there is no shepherd.
verses.en_bbe: For the images have said what is not true, and the readers of signs have seen deceit; they have given accounts of false dreams, they give comfort to no purpose: so they go out of the way like sheep, they are troubled because they have no keeper.

verses.en: Mine anger was kindled against the shepherds, and I punished the goats: for the LORD of hosts hath visited his flock the house of Judah, and hath made them as his goodly horse in the battle.
verses.pt: Minha ira se acendeu contra os pastores, e castigarei os bodes; mas o SENHOR dos exércitos visitará seu rebanho, a casa de Judá, e fará com que sejam como seu cavalo de honra na batalha.
verses.en_web: My anger is kindled against the shepherds, and I will punish the male goats; For Yahweh of Armies has visited his flock, the house of Judah, and will make them as his majestic horse in the battle.
verses.en_bbe: My wrath is burning against the keepers of the flock, and I will send punishment on the he-goats: for the Lord of armies takes care of his flock, the people of Judah, and will make them like the horse of his pride in the fight.

verses.en: Out of him came forth the corner, out of him the nail, out of him the battle bow, out of him every oppressor together.
verses.pt: De ele sairá a pedra angular, a estaca, e o arco da guerra; dele juntamente sairá todo dominador.
verses.en_web: From him will come the cornerstone, from him the nail, from him the battle bow, from him every ruler together.
verses.en_bbe: From him will come the keystone, from him the nail, from him the bow of war, from him will come every ruler;

verses.en: And they shall be as mighty men, which tread down their enemies in the mire of the streets in the battle: and they shall fight, because the LORD is with them, and the riders on horses shall be confounded.
verses.pt: E serão como guerreiros que pisam o inimigo na lama das ruas na batalha; e lutarão, porque o SENHOR estará com eles; e envergonharão aos que montam em cavalos.
verses.en_web: They shall be as mighty men, treading down muddy streets in the battle; and they shall fight, because Yahweh is with them; and the riders on horses will be confounded.
verses.en_bbe: Together they will be like men of war, crushing down their haters into the earth of the streets in the fight; they will make war because the Lord is with them: and the horsemen will be shamed.

verses.en: And I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph, and I will bring them again to place them; for I have mercy upon them: and they shall be as though I had not cast them off: for I am the LORD their God, and will hear them.
verses.pt: E eu fortalecerei a casa de Judá, e salvarei a casa de José; e voltarei a estabelecê-los, porque me compadeci deles; e serão como se eu não tivesse os rejeitado, porque eu sou o SENHOR, Deus deles, que os ouvirei.
verses.en_web: “I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph, and I will bring them back; for I have mercy on them; and they will be as though I had not cast them off: for I am Yahweh their God, and I will hear them.
verses.en_bbe: And I will make the children of Judah strong, and I will be the saviour of the children of Joseph, and I will make them come back again, for I have had mercy on them: they will be as if I had not given them up: for I am the Lord their God and I will give them an answer.

verses.en: And they of Ephraim shall be like a mighty man, and their heart shall rejoice as through wine: yea, their children shall see it, and be glad; their heart shall rejoice in the LORD.
verses.pt: E Efraim será como guerreiro, e seu coração se alegrará como de vinho; seus filhos verão, e ficarão contentes; seus corações se alegrarão no SENHOR.
verses.en_web: Ephraim will be like a mighty man, and their heart will rejoice as through wine; yes, their children will see it, and rejoice. Their heart will be glad in Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And Ephraim will be like a man of war, and their hearts will be glad as with wine; and their children will see it with joy; their hearts will be glad in the Lord.

verses.en: I will hiss for them, and gather them; for I have redeemed them: and they shall increase as they have increased.
verses.pt: Eu assoviarei a eles, e os ajuntarei, porque eu os resgatarei; e serão muitos assim como eram muitos no passado.
verses.en_web: I will signal for them, and gather them; for I have redeemed them; and they will increase as they have increased.
verses.en_bbe: With the sound of the pipe I will get them together; for I have given the price to make them free: and they will be increased as they were increased.

verses.en: And I will sow them among the people: and they shall remember me in far countries; and they shall live with their children, and turn again.
verses.pt: E eu os semearei entre os povos, e se lembrarão de mim em lugares remotos; e viverão com seus filhos, e voltarão.
verses.en_web: I will sow them among the peoples; and they will remember me in far countries; and they will live with their children, and will return.
verses.en_bbe: Though I had them planted among the peoples, they will keep me in mind in far countries: and they will take care of their children and will come back.

verses.en: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and place shall not be found for them.
verses.pt: Eu os trarei de volta da terra do Egito, e os recolherei da Assíria; e os trarei à terra de Gileade e do Líbano, mas não será espaço suficiente para eles.
verses.en_web: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and there won’t be room enough for them.
verses.en_bbe: And I will make them come back out of the land of Egypt, and will get them together out of Assyria; and I will take them into the land of Gilead, and it will not be wide enough for them.

verses.en: And he shall pass through the sea with affliction, and shall smite the waves in the sea, and all the deeps of the river shall dry up: and the pride of Assyria shall be brought down, and the sceptre of Egypt shall depart away.
verses.pt: Ele passará pela mar da aflição, ferirá as ondas do mar, e todas as profundezas do rio se secarão; e a arrogância dos assírios será derrubada, e o cetro do Egito será tomado.
verses.en_web: He will pass through the sea of affliction, and will strike the waves in the sea, and all the depths of the Nile will dry up; and the pride of Assyria will be brought down, and the scepter of Egypt will depart.
verses.en_bbe: And they will go through the sea of Egypt, and all the deep waters of the Nile will become dry: and the pride of Assyria will be made low, and the power of Egypt will be taken away.

verses.en: And I will strengthen them in the LORD; and they shall walk up and down in his name, saith the LORD.
verses.pt: E eu os fortificarei no SENHOR, e andarão em seu nome, diz o SENHOR.
verses.en_web: I will strengthen them in Yahweh; and they will walk up and down in his name,” says Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And their strength will be in the Lord; and their pride will be in his name, says the Lord.
